ingredients.name: egg wash: 1 egg beaten with a splash of milk

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Mix flour, sugar, salt and butter in the mixer with the paddle on low until pea-sized pieces remain. Add the ice water and mix just until it clumps.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Divide in two discs, wrap, and chill.

steps.title: Prepare the filling
steps.text: Toss apples with sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon and lemon juice.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Roll out one disc and line a 23 cm pie dish. Add the filling and dot with butter. Roll the second disc, cover the pie, crimp the edges, cut vents, and brush with egg wash.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake hot for 20 minutes, then lower the heat and bake until golden and the juices bubble. Cool for at least 2 hours before slicing.

ingredients.name: filling: corn syrup or maple syrup

steps.title: Make and chill the dough
steps.text: Mix crust ingredients in the mixer with the paddle until pea-sized pieces remain, add the ice water until it clumps, form a disc, and chill.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: Roll out and fit into a 23 cm pie dish. Line with parchment and weights and bake, then remove the weights and bake 5 minutes more.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.text: Whisk eggs, brown sugar, syrup, melted butter, vanilla and salt. Stir in the pecans.

steps.title: Fill and bake
steps.text: Pour into the crust and bake until the edges are set and the center has a slight jiggle. Cool completely so it sets.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.text: Mix flour, powdered sugar and butter with the paddle on low until sandy, add yolk and water, and mix until it comes together. Chill.

steps.title: Line the molds
steps.text: Press 30 g of dough into each hole of a 12-cup muffin tin or tart molds, building up the sides evenly.

steps.title: Make the custard
steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool for a few minutes. Whisk in eggs, milk and vanilla, then strain for a smooth custard.

steps.title: Fill and bake
steps.text: Fill each shell about 80 percent full. Bake hot for 10 minutes, then lower the heat until the custard is set and just wobbles.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.text: Simmer the apples with sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice and cornstarch for 6 to 8 minutes until tender and thick. Cool completely.

steps.title: Cut and fill
steps.text: Cut the pastry into 6 squares. Spoon filling onto one half of each, brush the edges with egg, and fold into triangles.

steps.title: Seal
steps.text: Press the edges with a fork, brush the tops with egg wash, and cut small steam vents.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until puffed and deep golden.

ingredients.name: egg wash: 1 egg beaten with a splash of milk

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Unfold the pastry and cut into 6 rectangles.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.text: Place a line of chocolate near one short edge of each rectangle, roll up once, add another line of chocolate, and roll to the end. Place seam side down on a lined tray.

steps.title: Glaze and bake
steps.text: Brush with egg wash and bake until deep golden and puffed.

steps.title: Make and bake the shell
steps.text: Mix crust ingredients with the paddle until the dough comes together, chill 1 hour, then roll into a 23 cm tart pan. Blind bake with weights, remove them, and bake until golden.

steps.title: Cook the pastry cream
steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming. Whisk sugar, yolks and cornstarch, pour in the milk, return to the pot, and whisk over medium heat until thick and bubbling. Off the heat, stir in butter and vanilla.

steps.title: Chill the cream
steps.text: Press plastic wrap onto the surface and chill until cold.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread the cream into the cooled shell, arrange the fruit, and brush with warmed, strained apricot jam.
